correction: The existing narrow R-STU-14 route permits an undated PhD/qualifying visiting student ONE actual capture-year point without literal Current. It requires nonalumni, plain-list and PI-first400 ownership guards plus other ordinary source/window/identity checks. The broader explicit-current membership route and older-lab additions restriction do not repeal R-STU-14. Earlier report phrasing implying absence of literal Current universally prevents a PhD capture point was too broad.
implications: Baris nine current-section PhD entries pass exact original first400 ownership and member-list quote predicates tested here. R-STU-14 may date an eligible actual capture2026 point after original candidate/source/faculty guards, without needing a new-lab exception. No earlier/later years or degree awards inferred.

Joshua eight PhD name-list predicates pass, but exact original2106 raw first400 contains no Smith; first Joshua668/Smith678. This raw carrier fails the existing ownership-head predicate as implemented. Actual lab ownership is clear elsewhere in the source; any alternate admission must independently satisfy an existing route, not waive this guard.

Joshua two undergraduate names and Hwang six masters cards do not gain dates under R-STU-14. Hwang visiting-student row requires actual role/plain-list/ownership/capture guards; the foreign PhD programme label alone is not visit-date proof.

All as-filled R1/X failures, U/R2 numbers, bootstrap,64strict gaps,18Sidd school-scope cautions, peritem membership/role evidence and immutable root worksheet remain unchanged. No replacement final signoff or acceptance.
